rows.en: Celica: "No..."
Clovis: "The castle... Has it fallen...?"
Ai: "No, that can't be true!"
Ymir: "Miyasco, any response?!"
Miyasco: "None!"
Celica: "What about Prana readings?"
Miyasco: "U-Um... Identification...
They're all Zigrim forces!"
Clovis: "Even what we can see is a pretty large force."
Derock: "..."
Miyasco: "Oh, they're transmitting a warning signal!"
Arthur: "A warning? Why would the Zigrim side...?"
Touya: "What's going on?"
Ymir: "This signal is defined by the International League Treaty
as an attack warning signal.
It's supposed to be sent when there's a chance
that civilians will be harmed."
Touya: "So, in other words, they're declaring
that they're about to attack?"
Celica: "Yes. But it's odd. Going out of their way to send a signal
like this... Could it be a trap?"
Derock: "The enemy's guidance system has locked on to us.
Oh, they've just fired."
Celica: "Whoa, it was real?!
Form the Plasma Field! Quickly!"
Celica: "Damage report?!"
Miyasco: "U-Um..."
Derock: "Only the first layer of armor on the port side is scorched.
There's no effect on our ability to sail."
Celica: "All right, Liebhofen, full speed astern!"
Ai: "What do you mean, astern?!"
Baren: "...Understood."
Ai: "Are you all out of your minds?! Alforina
is still there! Why are we retreating?!"
Arthur: "In those circumstances, there's no..."
Ai: "You don't know that! You don't!"
Ymir: "Ai, we'll be picked off if we stay like this.
Let's fall back and regroup for now."
Derock: "They've locked on again."
Celica: "Ai, we'll talk later! Engines full!"
Baren: "...Engines full!"
Touya: "..."
Fores: "What happened? What was that bombardment just now?"
Reamond: "Sorry. The new recruits are still
worked up... Right?"
Subordinate: "What?! Oh, yes. That's exactly right!"
Fores: "New recruits...? I don't see any
such people here."
Reamond: "They must have run away, afraid you'd knock some sense into them, Lieutenant Colonel.
Right?"
Subordinate: "Y-Yes! That's exactly right!"
Fores: "I heard a report that Liebhofen
had been sighted."
Subordinate: "Uh..."
Fores: "..."
Reamond: "...Who knows?"
Fores: "...Very well.
In recognition of your achievement in slaying Tyron of the Three Sword Knights,
I won't pursue this.
But don't think there'll be a second time."
Reamond: "...Good for you."
Subordinate: "Yes, ma'am! Thank you!"
Fores: "That includes you, Lieutenant!"
Reamond: "Ha ha ha ha... Yes, ma'am. Thank you.
...More importantly, how's the search inside going?"
Fores: "...Honestly. It's completely empty inside.
They probably evacuated the civilians long ago.
That decision deserves praise.
But to abandon a trusted retainer and flee...
Utterly contemptible."
Reamond: "Quite right, quite right.
But I get the feeling there's more to it than that.
Well, it's only a feeling..."
Fores: "In any case, this place is under our occupation now.
Tomorrow morning, leaving two companies here, we head for Belnea Fort on the border.
Rest while you can."
Reamond: "Our next opponent is that 'Sword Radiance,'
Garyud Via Vratzen...?"
Fores: "Yes. The man who once single-handedly routed our army's elite troops,
two battalions of them..."
Reamond: "Even with guerrilla tactics, it's hard to believe.
I'd rather not meet him on the battlefield."
Fores: "What's wrong? With a 'Sword Radiance' as your opponent,
have you lost your nerve after all?"
Reamond: "Well, there are only three on the continent
who hold the 'Sword Radiance' title.
And if he also has 'Phantom Saint,' the highest knightly rank,
attached to that title...
Someone like me can't stand up to him."
Fores: "To hear words like that from you..."
Reamond: "Lieutenant Colonel, the trick to never losing a battle
is not to fight anyone stronger than you."
Fores: "Then Tyron was weaker than you.
Is that what you're saying?"
Reamond: "No, no, not at all.
He was more skilled than I was.
He couldn't retreat, while we could use our numbers.
That's all there was to it.
Though even if I couldn't win, I didn't feel I would lose."
Fores: "...You really are a strange man.
You seem unreliable, yet somehow full of confidence..."
Reamond: "Oh? Have you finally noticed my charm?
Then how about tonight...?"
Fores: "...Hurry up and get ready!"
Reamond: "Ow, ow, ow... This is another form
of love... Right...?"
Subordinate: "I don't think so, Lieutenant!"
Clovis: "Strange. No one's pursuing us...
And that warning before the attack..."
Arthur: "It seemed they deliberately stopped attacking
partway through, too."
Derock: "They simply got scared, I'm sure.
Well, if it comes to that, you can go out
and scatter them.
Just keep fighting like workhorses."
Clovis: "Someone shut that big guy up. He's getting on my nerves."
Derock: "How rude...
Someone like that..."
Touya: "...What are you writing?"
Derock: "Y-You can't look.
I don't show my 'revenge list' to anyone..."
Touya: "R-Revenge list?"
Miyasco: "Oh, don't worry about it.
He does it all the time."
Touya: "All the time...?"
Ai: "Why are you all so relaxed?!
How can you act so normal?!"
Ymir: "Ai..."
Ai: "...This is wrong... Aren't you worried about her,
or about everyone else?
Why doesn't anyone say we should go help them?!"
Arthur: "I'm sorry, but the castle is already..."
Ai: "I know that! But maybe..."
Arthur: "It's true that the Zigrim army probably hasn't
taken complete control yet.
A considerable force was still stationed there."
Ai: "Then...!"
Arthur: "That's exactly why we can't. It may sound cold,
but our purpose is to protect Liebhofen and the Spirit Mechs,
and prepare for and deal with the revival of ≪Ze=Ode≫."
Ai: "How can you be so calm?!
We all owe them so much!
To just say goodbye and leave them like this...
How can you do that?!"
Ymir: "Nobody is saying..."
Ai: "Fine! I'll go by myself...!"
Clovis: "That's enough!
Do you think you're the only one who's hurting?!
The queen and everyone helped us, too!
...We don't want to retreat, either..."
Clovis: "...You saw the situation.
Even if she's alive, she'd already be a prisoner.
If we rush in to rescue her, they might use the queen as a shield
and force us into unconditional surrender.
Do you think that's what she'd want?"
Ai: "That's..."
Ymir: "I understand how much it hurts.
But there's nothing we can do right now... Please understand."
Ai: "But... We made a promise...
To make cookies together next time...
She was... just an ordinary fourteen-year-old girl..."
Ymir: "Ai..."
Touya: "H-Hey!"
Celica: "Let's leave her alone for now.
Her head understands, but her heart hasn't accepted it yet."
Touya: "Are you all right?"
Celica: "...I'm all right.
Ymir: "Anyway, there's no point acting on our own right now.
Let's go to the Holy Land for now."
Arthur: "...Yes.
Xiujian and Aurelie are there, too,
and we need to think about what to do next."
Fain: "Is it all right to head straight for the Holy Land?
Even with Ymir and Lady Celica aboard,
wouldn't we be violating their airspace?"
Clovis: "Come to think of it, the Holy Land
is inside the Kingdom of Agarthia.
It's more or less borrowing space from them...
If they find a pretext, in the worst case,
they might even seize the Spirit Mechs."
Celica: "That won't be a problem. This ship
is equipped with an 'optical cloaking system.'"
Clovis: "Optical cloaking...
That's something like stealth, right?"
Arthur: "No, it's much more impressive.
Besides a high degree of stealth, it should also be able
to change the refractive index of the light people's eyes receive..."
Touya: "So, what does that mean?"
Celica: "It means people can't see us,
and radar won't pick us up, either."
Touya: "What a convenient thing to have aboard..."
Ymir: "Then let's go.
Baren, please take us there."
Baren: "...Understood.
Setting course for the Holy Land."
Miyasco: "...? Oh!"
Celica: "What's wrong?"
Miyasco: "A-A battle. Armored Mechs are fighting!"
Clovis: "...We can already see it with our own eyes.
What on earth are you doing?"
Miyasco: "I'm sorry..."
Derock: "It can't be helped. She's normally
in charge of communications. We're short-handed.
If you're going to complain, do it yourself."
Clovis: "What?! What did you say?!"
Ymir: "H-Hold on!
This isn't the time for that!"
Celica: "Anyway, hurry with the data analysis!"
